for.en: People who rent: your stuff, what you owe your landlord or neighbors, and somewhere to stay after a loss
for.zh: 在外租屋的人：保你的東西、你對房東和鄰居的責任，和出事後暫住的費用

questions.en: What's your ZIP code? (or city and state)
questions.zh: 你的郵遞區號？（或城市和州）

questions.en: About how big is the place, in square feet?
Which floor do you live on?

options.en: Building with a doorman or controlled entry
options.zh: 有門禁或管理員的大樓

options.en: A room in a shared house
options.zh: 合租房子裡的一個房間

questions.en: What would it cost to replace everything you own there? (furniture, electronics, clothes)
questions.zh: 家裡的東西全部重買大約要多少錢？（家具、3C、衣服）

questions.en: Of that, how much is in single items worth over $1,500 (cameras, jewelry, watches)?
questions.zh: 其中單件超過 1,500 美元的貴重物品總共多少？（相機、珠寶、名錶）

questions.en: How many renters or homeowners claims have you made in the last three years?
questions.zh: 過去三年申請過幾次租屋或房屋理賠？

questions.en: Which deductible? (higher means a lower price)
questions.zh: 自負額要多少？（越高保費越低）

coverages.en: Your stuff (fire, theft, burst pipes, windstorm, accidental damage)
coverages.zh: 個人財物（火災、竊盜、水管破裂、風災、意外損壞）
對他人的責任（房東、鄰居、訪客）

coverages.en: Somewhere to stay when your place can't be lived in
coverages.zh: 房子不能住時的暫住費用

coverages.en: Medical bills of a guest hurt in your home
coverages.zh: 訪客在你家受傷的醫療費

addons.en: Valuables listed item by item (loss and accidental damage too, no deductible)
addons.zh: 貴重物品逐項保（含遺失、意外損壞，不扣自負額）

addons.en: Device protection (dropped or wet phones and laptops)
addons.zh: 3C 意外損壞（手機、筆電摔壞或進水）

claims.en: A phone or laptop was dropped or got wet
A leak or burst pipe damaged my stuff
claims.zh: 漏水或水管破裂弄壞東西

claims.en: I damaged my landlord's or a neighbor's property
claims.zh: 我弄壞了房東或鄰居的東西

claims.en: My place can't be lived in for now
A guest was hurt in my home

clauses.en: "Your stuff" (personal property) is what you or family living with you own and keep at the insured address: furniture, appliances, clothes and personal electronics. Vehicles, cash, securities, pets and business property are not personal property.
clauses.zh: 「個人財物」指你本人或同住家人所有、放在承保地址內的物品，包括家具、電器、衣物和個人用 3C 產品。車輛、現金、有價證券、寵物和營業用的物品不屬於個人財物。

clauses.en: "Replacement cost" is what it costs to replace a lost item with a new one of the same kind and quality. We pay replacement cost without depreciation, except where RT-4.3 caps it.
clauses.zh: 「重置成本」指用同等級、同功能的新品取代損失物品所需的費用。我們依重置成本理賠，不扣折舊，但 RT-4.3 另有上限者除外。

clauses.en: When your stuff is damaged or lost through fire, smoke, lightning, explosion, theft, a burst pipe or sudden leak, or windstorm or hail getting inside, we pay replacement cost less the deductible, up to the personal property limit on the policy. A theft must be reported to the police within 24 hours of finding it, with the report number.
clauses.zh: 個人財物因火災、煙燻、雷擊、爆炸、竊盜、水管破裂或突發漏水，或風災、冰雹進入屋內而毀損或滅失時，我們依重置成本扣除自負額理賠，以保單所載個人財物保額為上限。竊盜須於發現後 24 小時內報警，並提供報案編號。

clauses.en: When you are legally liable for damage to the property of, or injury to, your landlord, a neighbor or a guest, we pay it, up to $100,000 per occurrence, and defend you. Don't admit liability or settle without our agreement.
clauses.zh: 你依法應對房東、鄰居或訪客的財物損壞或身體傷害負賠償責任時，我們代為賠償並為你抗辯，每一事故以 10 萬美元為上限。未經我們同意，請勿承認責任或私下和解。

clauses.en: When an insured event makes your place unlivable, we pay reasonable costs of staying elsewhere (a hotel or short-term rental), up to $100 a day and $3,000 in all, until you can move back or for 30 days at most.
clauses.zh: 承保事故使承保地址無法居住時，我們支付合理的暫住費用（旅館或短租），每日最高 100 美元，合計最高 3,000 美元，直到可以入住或滿 30 日為止。

clauses.en: When a guest is accidentally hurt at your place, whether or not it was your fault, we pay their medical bills up to $1,000 a person, with no deductible. Not for you or family living with you.
clauses.zh: 訪客在承保地址內意外受傷，不論你是否有過失，我們支付其醫療費用，每人最高 1,000 美元，不扣自負額。你本人和同住家人不適用。

clauses.en: No payment for loss caused on purpose or by fraud, by you, family living with you, or anyone acting for them.
clauses.zh: 故意行為、詐欺，或你本人、同住家人或其指使之人所造成的損失，不予理賠。

clauses.en: No payment for flood or surface water, earthquake, wear and tear, rust, pests, mold, slow leaks (going on for more than 14 days), or a defect in the item itself. Flood and earthquake need separate cover.
clauses.zh: 洪水或地表積水、地震、自然耗損、生鏽、蟲害、黴菌、逐漸滲漏（持續超過 14 日），以及物品本身的瑕疵，不予理賠。洪水與地震須另行投保。

clauses.en: No payment for things lost, left behind or missing (not stolen), except valuables listed under RT-5.1.
clauses.zh: 物品遺失、遺忘或下落不明（不是被偷），不予理賠；但依 RT-5.1 逐項加保的貴重物品除外。

clauses.en: No payment for events in the first 14 days of the policy, except fire and theft (the waiting period).
clauses.zh: 保單生效後 14 日內發生的事故，除火災和竊盜外，不予理賠（等待期）。

clauses.en: No payment for war, nuclear events, confiscation by a government, or theft and water damage while the home has been vacant for more than 60 days in a row.
clauses.zh: 戰爭、核子事故、政府沒收，以及承保地址連續空置超過 60 日期間發生的竊盜和水損，不予理賠。

clauses.en: To claim, tell us what happened, when and where, list what was lost, and give photos, receipts or repair estimates. We may ask for more; give it within 30 days.
clauses.zh: 申請理賠時，你須說明發生了什麼事、何時何地、損失物品清單，並提供照片、收據或維修估價。我們可以要求補件，你應在 30 日內提供。

clauses.en: If a claim includes false information or hides an important fact, we may deny it and cancel the policy, and any payment made must be returned.
clauses.zh: 申請時提供不實資料或隱匿重要事實，我們得拒絕理賠並終止保單；已付的理賠款應返還。

clauses.en: A single item over $1,500 that isn't listed under RT-5.1 is paid up to $1,500; an item with no proof of purchase is paid at the market price of similar items.
clauses.zh: 單件物品超過 1,500 美元而未依 RT-5.1 加保者，以 1,500 美元為上限；無法提供購買證明的物品，以同類物品的市價為準。

clauses.en: One deductible per occurrence. Losses from one cause within 72 hours are one occurrence.
clauses.zh: 每一事故扣除一次自負額。同一原因在 72 小時內造成的多項損失視為同一事故。

clauses.en: Listed valuables are each covered up to the amount listed, including loss and accidental damage, with no deductible.
clauses.zh: 加保的貴重物品逐項列在保單上，以列載金額為上限；保障擴及遺失和意外損壞，且不扣自負額。

clauses.en: Device protection: when your phone, tablet or laptop is damaged by a drop, a knock or liquid, we pay the repair, or replacement cost if it can't be repaired, up to $2,000 a year and twice a year per device. The deductible is $50 a claim (instead of the policy's deductible under RT-4.4).
clauses.zh: 3C 意外損壞：你的手機、平板、筆電因掉落、碰撞或液體造成損壞，我們支付維修費，無法維修時依重置成本理賠，每年合計最高 2,000 美元，每件每年以兩次為限。每次自負額 50 美元（不適用 RT-4.4 的自負額）。

clauses.en: Pay monthly or yearly. If a monthly payment fails you have 14 days' grace with cover as usual; unpaid after that, the policy lapses from the end of the grace period and is reinstated when paid, but events while lapsed are not covered.
clauses.zh: 保費可月繳或年繳。月繳扣款失敗時有 14 日寬限期，期間保障照常；逾期未繳，保單自寬限期屆滿日起停效，補繳後復效，停效期間發生的事故不予理賠。

clauses.en: Cancel any time: we refund the premium for the days left, with no fee. Change the policy any time: it is priced again at once, and we refund or charge the difference.
clauses.zh: 你可以隨時退保，我們依未經過的日數退還保費，不收手續費。保單內容可隨時變更，變更後立即重新計價，多退少補。

clauses.en: 20% of the premium is Cover's flat fee; the rest goes to the claims pool, for claims and reinsurance. After the year closes, what is left in the pool of your chosen cause's group is given to that cause, not refunded to anyone.
clauses.zh: 保費的 20% 為 Cover 的固定費用，其餘進入理賠池，用於理賠與再保險。年度結算後，你所選公益組別的理賠池若有剩餘，捐給該公益團體，不退還給個人。
